design.decision: Spend winners defending against the opponents' contract instead of padding your own.
design.opponent: Revealed when they are set; opponents bid more cautiously against this team.
design.rationale: A ×multiplier that rewards a defensive decision and lets a trailing team swing a round, unlike payoffs that grow an existing lead.
design.draftText: ×1.5 contract multiplier if the opponents miss their contract

history.note: draft-uncommon: merged into ub-opp-set-xmult, the same design (signature) from another cluster; the amount sweep decides the number.
